_comment: SWARM Messenger packaged-build endpoints (NODE_ENV=production, which is what a packaged app always uses). Every Signal endpoint, Signal zk parameter, Signal trust root, Signal update feed and the Stripe key are gone. Until SWARM runs a separate production server this points at the same staging host as config/swarm-staging.json; docs/SWARM-CONFIG.md records that and what has to change when a production server exists.
